scenes.headline: How an agent watches your coding agents
scenes.sub: Uber's ADR, Agentic Detection and Response, and its two-tier detector.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Seaweed! Uber's ADR isn't architecture decision records. It's Agentic Detection and Response: an agent that watches your coding agents.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Run cheap triage on every session, and escalate only the ambiguous few to an agent that investigates, reading a suspicious tool's own source before it decides.
scenes.mark: reading a suspicious tool's own source

items.text: An email plants a Jira ticket
items.say: An email creates a Jira ticket with hidden instructions.

items.text: The agent reads it through MCP
items.say: A developer's coding agent fetches it through an MCP server, as ordinary context.

items.text: Secrets leave in an outbound call
items.say: It's steered into reading a secrets file and sending it out. Nobody typed a malicious command.

steps.say: A sensor on each laptop records what an agent did, and the prompts and reasoning behind it: what ordinary endpoint tools can't see.
Tier one: a cheap model reads the whole transcript in one call. Clearly benign? It returns right there. That early return is the cost control.
Anything ambiguous defaults to suspicious, and goes to tier two: a Claude Code session, run as a subprocess.
It investigates through three MCP servers: one fetches the flagged tool's actual source, one looks up known techniques, one checks policy.
Its verdict comes back as structured JSON, and a threat goes to a human.

scenes.title: F1 when the agent loses one tool
scenes.note: Uber's own ablation, on its own benchmark
scenes.say: Take away the tool that fetches source, and F1 drops from zero point eight to zero point six seven six: the biggest drop of any part.

scenes.text: The interesting engineering is routing: the right amount of reasoning at the right moment, not a bigger judge model.

recap: Tier one: cheap triage, early return on benign
Tier two: an agent that reads the tool's source
Precision comes from routing, not a bigger judge
scenes.say: To recap: triage everything cheaply, investigate the few, and let the agent read the code.
